opening.argument: A €100 starter package provides 1,000 tokens, and the speaker says those tokens can be mined to make coins. That directly ties participation to paying for a package and to mining-related coin generation. The presentation also connects matching bonuses to generations and four-level qualification, while a slide shows a referral structure alongside euro bonus amounts. These are not isolated mentions of value: the speaker says OneCoin was once 50 cents and is now roughly €5.65, and forecasts €100 in about two years. Together, the paid packages, coin-generation process, referral-linked bonuses and unusually large projected value establish a promotional paid-mining or node-returns offer. The video also reports earnings and withdrawal figures and displays registration and KYC requests for personal and identity information. The claims, actual payments, liquidity and completed losses remain unverified.
